limits.item: The actual H&E reader inherits an IHC technology schematic labeled Stained protein (HER2, PD-L1), while the H&E definition says the broad stain is not a named-protein measurement.

In both stromal-area themes a green region partly occludes/abuts a pink excluded nest. The native whole views support a low illustrative ambiguity; the geometry selector did not independently calculate the overlap. Source bytes and prior grades are untouched.
Historical focus returned to BODY after Escape. This was not re-tested and is not closed by source identity or fresh native views.

Three full abstracts, two Roach method/results paragraphs and specified official text/pages are read; no whole primary paper or full guidance document was read. The original CPS full text remains unavailable; its abstract supports the general definition, not the TNBC tables.

Review/PASS labels, stage-specific hashes, actor/model claims, private capture paths and route-successor fit retain historical scope. Alt/caption duplicate strings match both pinned owners. No historical path was followed or source commit fetched.

Nine existing histopathology short values were corrected by machine assistance. Review marks remain unchanged; no named language acceptance. Eighteen H&E/TPS English fallbacks also change, giving 27 effective output changes.

Existing CPS/TPS forPatient text, assay-comparison/cytology assertions, authorization tables and linked study/product-card claims remain outside this source-method selection. In particular, generic treatment gates and early-versus-advanced TNBC card wording require their own current source review; this packet does not certify them.
I05 category-row layout and P09 grouped-inventory geometry remain explicit artifact conventions with represented measurement/eligibility invariants and no extra scientific credit.

Eight Mermaid source instances (five unique bodies) were read in context but not rendered. Native Sharp/vips views do not establish hosted browser, mobile, hydration, measured contrast or accessibility acceptance.

Archived CAP 2018, Agilent EU manual and original CPS full text were inaccessible through the recorded direct routes. FDA technical labeling and RCPath Table 8 supply bounded alternatives; cached search text is not raw verified source.
All unrelated ordinary, adjacent, schema and literature gaps remain. Six unapplied immunopeptidome requirements and the P44 matrix proposal remain open.
